cues: Sodium carbonate is a special case worth knowing.
It is neutralised in two stages, so its curve has two steps.
First, carbonate takes one proton and becomes bicarbonate, near pH eight point three.
text: Sodium carbonate is a special case worth knowing. It is neutralised in two stages, so its curve has two steps. First, carbonate takes one proton and becomes bicarbonate, near pH eight point three. Phenolphthalein turns colourless here.
